decisionBox.changed: Midday held REDUCE and both of midday's gates correctly refused. Its 78,682.0 reduce gate did not fire - the lowest settled hourly close since was 78,951.0 at 22:00 UTC and the lowest low 78,774.1, so price came within 92.1 points of the trigger and turned. Its 79,660.0 add gate did not fire either - the highest settled close was 79,367.4 and the session high 79,419.3, 240.7 points short. Price marks 79,159.7 against a 79,180.7 midday mark, a 21.0-point drift. So the levels were right and the tape went nowhere, and the stance moves from REDUCE to a small ADD for one reason: the positioning condition that has capped or blocked every add this week finally reversed. Open interest FELL 1.46 percent from 2,186,965,596 to 2,155,023,434 USD while price was flat - the first decline in four sessions after a run of 2,115,031,593 to 2,131,493,483 to 2,186,965,596. Funding halved from +0.0000481027 to +0.0000287363 per period. The OKX 1H long/short account ratio eased from 1.17 to 1.16. And for the first time today the liquidation flow has a real short side: 156,557 USD across 50 fills in the 79,250 bucket, 100 percent short, taken out on the bounce to 79,419.3. Midnight, morning and midday all wrote the same sentence - leverage keeps arriving long on every decline - and that sentence is no longer true tonight. Structure supports it modestly: a higher low at 78,774.1 against 78,682.0, the 4H EMA50 at 79,071.38 held with 88.3 points to spare, and the 1H MACD histogram crossed positive at +2.64 after being -53.35 at midday. What holds this to a SMALL add rather than a full one is the 4H MACD line, which has now crossed below zero at -16.79 for the first time in this leg exactly as midday warned it would, price is still under all four hourly EMAs, and the next report is six hours away across the overnight gap with the US ETF channel shut for Labor Day.

overnightRisk: The gap between this report and the ~02:00 COT midnight run is the thinnest book of the week and it carries four specific hazards. ONE - the US spot Bitcoin ETF creation and redemption channel has been shut all day for Labor Day and stays shut until Tuesday 08 September; BTC has now completed a fourth consecutive session with neither an institutional bid nor an institutional seller, and the confirmed Farside record still ends at 04 September +174.6m across 681 unchanged dated rows. Every price print overnight is leverage on a thin book, and today leverage moved this tape twice. TWO - the 78,750 bucket is 409.7 points below spot and it is the largest cluster on the map at 252,449 USD across 28 fills, 100 percent long. It has already been struck once today at the 78,682.0 low, but open interest rebuilt above it through the afternoon before falling back this evening, so it is partially reloaded rather than spent. A gap through 78,774.0 does not stop at the reduce gate; the magnet pulls to 78,682.0 and then 78,650.0, and under that the 4H EMA100 at 77,407.39 is the next structural reference, 1,752 points lower. THREE - the reduce gate is close-based and a gap does not respect closes. That is precisely why the resting stop at 78,650.0 is recommended tonight rather than left optional: 509.7 points and 1.82 hourly ATRs below spot, under both the session low and the 04 September low, it is the only thing that acts while nobody is watching. FOUR - Asia opens into this. Tokyo trades Tuesday even though the US ETF wrapper does not, and JPXN is the one non-crypto asset sitting rich at the 84th percentile of its 21-day band, so a risk-off Tokyo session has nothing cheap to fall back on. The offsetting fact, and it is a real one, is that this is the first evening in four where open interest fell instead of rising into weakness, funding halved and shorts rather than longs were the ones being liquidated. The overnight tail is fatter to the downside; it is no longer being actively reloaded.

liquidation.note: 252,449 USD across 28 filled OKX BTC-USDT-SWAP liquidations, 100 percent LONG-side, inside the rolling 100-fill window that spans 15:42 UTC to 00:20 UTC. It stays the magnet because it is still the largest cluster on the map and it sits directly beneath tonight's reduce gate.

156,557 USD across 50 fills, 100 percent SHORT-side, realized on the bounce toward the 79,419.3 session high. This is the change of the evening. At midday the entire short-side inventory above spot was a single 1,377 USD fill; it is now 114 times larger and it is the second-largest cluster on the map. Shorts pressed the break of 79,000 and got taken out 250 points higher. It sits 90.3 points above spot and it means the squeeze fuel is no longer exclusively on the long side.

Repairing, not repaired. Price is still below all four hourly EMAs, which is the condition midday flagged as new, but the distance has collapsed: the EMA200 at 79,263.06 is 103.4 points overhead against 130.5 at midday, and the EMA20 at 79,301.58 is 141.9 points. The nine most recent hourly closes read 79,031.0, 79,192.5, 79,195.5, 79,367.4, 79,237.4, 79,158.3, 78,951.0, 79,111.8 and 79,184.3 - a higher low at 78,774.1 against the 78,682.0 of the 17:00 hour, and a lower high at 79,419.3 against 79,648.1. Compression rather than trend. The genuine improvement is the MACD histogram, which has crossed positive at +2.64 with the line at -161.51 just above a -164.15 signal, after reading -53.35 and widening five hours ago.

The line in the sand held, and the momentum warning came true anyway. Price at 79,159.7 is 88.3 points above the 4H EMA50 at 79,071.38 - the pivot midday named - and it has now been defended twice, at the 78,682.0 low and again at 78,774.1. It remains below the EMA20 at 79,487.47. Meanwhile the MACD line has done exactly what midday said it was about to do and crossed below zero at -16.79 from a 119.35 signal, histogram -136.14, the first sub-zero 4H reading of this leg. So the structure holds while the momentum underneath it has turned negative. Lose the EMA50 on a settled 4H close and the next reference is the EMA100 at 77,407.39, 1,752 points lower.

Still the floor under the whole argument. The 07 September UTC daily candle settled at 79,111.8 from an 80,341.4 open, high 80,441.4, low 78,682.0 - a 1.53 percent down day and the second red daily in a row. Price remains above all four daily EMAs with a 2,181.7-point cushion over the EMA20 at 76,978.02, and RSI at 62.92 is barely changed from 62.94 at midday. The crack is the same one and it is widening slowly: the MACD histogram at -348.41 against -257.24 five hours ago, the line at 2,892.84 rolling further under a 3,241.25 signal. That is momentum cooling across a multi-day top formation, not a daily trend break.

calibration.rollingRecord: Midday held REDUCE with reduceIf 78,682.0, addIf 79,660.0 and invalidatesAt 78,650.0. Neither gate fired and the invalidation held. The reduce gate required a settled 1H close below 78,682.0; the lowest settled close since was 78,951.0 at 22:00 UTC and the lowest low 78,774.1, so it came within 92.1 points and correctly refused. The add gate required a settled close above 79,660.0; the highest settled close was 79,367.4 and the session high 79,419.3, missing by 240.7 points, also a correct refusal. Price marks 79,159.7 against the 79,180.7 midday mark, a 21.0-point drift, so neither acting nor not acting on the gates cost anything. The discretionary side is where midday earned it: it trimmed 12 percent of the spot core at 79,180.7 to rebuild cash from 9.72 to 32.66 USDT specifically to buy the 78,650-78,750 shelf. Price is 21.0 points lower, so the trim cost essentially nothing and the ammunition is real - which is what makes tonight's small add possible at all.
calibration.note: Four sessions today and the gates went four for four in direction. What changed tonight is the tell itself. Midnight, morning and midday all diagnosed the same condition in the same words - open interest rising into every decline, the account ratio walking 1.11 to 1.17, leverage rebuilding long straight through two seven-figure flushes - and all three correctly refused to add size on it. That condition has now inverted: open interest fell 1.46 percent on a flat tape, funding halved, the ratio eased to 1.16 and 28.3 percent of the liquidation flow was short-side against 2.7 percent five hours ago. This is the first evidence in four sessions that the trapdoor is being unloaded rather than reloaded. The discipline that follows is the same as it has been all week - size to the positioning, not to the price - and tonight that argues for a small tranche rather than none, with a resting stop under the invalidation because the reading is six hours old by the time the next report reads it.
